#### case Issue 727 - Given a deep nested if-else-if-statement without curly braces
#### code
fun main() {
    if (outerCondition1)
        if (innerCondition1)
            if (innerCondition11)
                return 0
            else if (innerCondition12)
                return 12
            else if (innerCondition13)
                return 13
            else
                return 14
        else if (innerCondition44)
            return 1
        else {
            return 16
        }
    else if (outerCondition2)
        if (innerCondition2)
            return 2
        else if (innerCondition3)
            return 3
        else
            return 4
    else
        if (innerCondition4)
            return 5
        else
            return -1
}
#### formatted
fun main() {
    if (outerCondition1) {
        if (innerCondition1) {
            if (innerCondition11) {
                return 0
            } else if (innerCondition12) {
                return 12
            } else if (innerCondition13) {
                return 13
            } else {
                return 14
            }
        } else if (innerCondition44) {
            return 1
        } else {
            return 16
        }
    } else if (outerCondition2) {
        if (innerCondition2) {
            return 2
        } else if (innerCondition3) {
            return 3
        } else {
            return 4
        }
    } else {
        if (innerCondition4) {
            return 5
        } else {
            return -1
        }
    }
}

#### case Given an return-if-statement
#### code
fun test(i: Int, j: Int): Int {
    return if (i == 1)
        if (j == 1)
            1
        else
            2
    else if (i == 2)
        if (j == 1)
            3
        else
            4
    else
        if (j == 1)
            5
        else
            6
}
#### formatted
fun test(i: Int, j: Int): Int {
    return if (i == 1) {
        if (j == 1) {
            1
        } else {
            2
        }
    } else if (i == 2) {
        if (j == 1) {
            3
        } else {
            4
        }
    } else {
        if (j == 1) {
            5
        } else {
            6
        }
    }
}

#### case Given an if-statement inside a lambda
#### code

        if (it == "")
            1
        else
            2
    } ?: 0
    return i
}
#### formatted

        if (it == "") {
            1
        } else {
            2
        }
    } ?: 0
    return i
}

#### case Issue 1079 - Given an if-statement without curly braces a function call argument
#### code
fun foo(x: Int, y: Int, z: Int) {}

    foo(
        a,
        if (bar) b else
            c,
        d
    )
}
#### formatted
fun foo(x: Int, y: Int, z: Int) {}

    foo(
        a,
        if (bar) {
            b
        } else {
            c
        },
        d
    )
}

#### case Issue 1904 - Given an nested if else statement followed by an elvis operator

} ?: "something-else"
